metadata.dataset_name: Dataset 5.2 - P0 Hardened Evidence / Source Dataset
metadata.purpose: P0 evidence layer for exact citations. Combines Dataset 5 registry with newly captured official page/clause or official webpage-section evidence.

evidence_levels.4: VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_EXACT_CLAUSE — official PDF + exact page + clause/section
evidence_levels.3: VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_SECTION — official PDF + exact page/section, no discrete clause
evidence_levels.2: VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_WEBPAGE — official live page + exact named section

metadata.production_rule: Prefer Level 4/3 for final rule verdicts. Level 2 is acceptable for live provider webpages when no PDF exists. Level 1 should not be the sole authority for high-confidence final eligibility.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Class XII/equivalent candidates need at least 60% marks, first-year admission in 2026-27 to an eligible course, and parents/guardian annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Exact current 2026 General Scholarship eligibility.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: The scheme repeats the 60% and ₹4.5 lakh conditions, bars most concurrent non-government trust/institution scholarships, and permits specified engineering lateral-entry cases after diploma with at least 60%.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Current 2026 conditions, concurrent scholarship restriction, and lateral-entry exception.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Renewal requires minimum course-specific marks, passing all subjects, and includes rules for grace marks, failed subjects, and one/two students per family.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Exact renewal and academic edge-case rules for LIC 2026.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Income certificate must be issued by a competent State Revenue Authority and state annual gross income of both parents from all sources for the preceding financial year; a certificate valid for the previous financial year is acceptable.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Exact 2026 income-certificate issuer and validity requirement.

normalized_fact.financial_year: preceding; previous FY certificate accepted if valid

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: For Top Class Scholarship, the revised provision provides fixed first-year grants of ₹45,000 and ₹30,000 under the stated conditions, including non-availing of the same through ARJUN portal for the latter.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Exact revised Top Class financial-assistance clause.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: The Build India Scholarship supports young engineers in pursuing M.Tech. in Construction Technology & Management, delivered with IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, NIT Trichy and NIT Surathkal.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Official confirmation of the Build India Scholarship programme, degree and partner institutions.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Official page requires confirmed first-year admission in specified engineering/future-tech courses at a top-50 NIRF Engineering institution, family income not above ₹8 lakh, Indian citizenship/residency, and no other scholarship/grant for the same academic purpose supported by the Foundation.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Current 2026-27 official eligibility section.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Official page lists identity proof, current-year admission proof, Class XII marksheet, entrance scorecard, income documents with six-month bank statements, applicant/parent/institution bank details, photo, achievements, applicable rent proof, and SOP.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Current official document checklist.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Reliance Foundation opened 2026-27 applications for first-year full-time UG and PG students; 5,000 UG scholarships of up to ₹2 lakh and 100 PG scholarships of up to ₹6 lakh are offered.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Official 2026-27 programme scope and benefit confirmation.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: UG applicants must be resident Indian citizens, have at least 60% in Class 12, be in first-year regular full-time degree study in 2026-27, have household income below ₹15 lakh, and take the aptitude test.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Exact current UG eligibility section.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Current site says applicants must have passed Class 10 from a local government school, passed Class 12 from a government school/junior college in 2025-26, and enrolled in an undergraduate programme beginning 2026-27.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Current 2026-27 official-program eligibility.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: The programme supports 1,000 eligible girls in Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra, pays ₹30,000 per year, and lists 15 October 2026 as the deadline.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Current states, benefit and deadline.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Panasonic states Ratti Chhatr provides financial assistance to aspiring engineers at IITs across India and is open to first-year engineering students from low-income families.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Official programme eligibility core, though not a full 2026-27 application rule set.

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: Tata Capital says Pankh financially supports academically bright youth from economically challenged communities, with special attention to women, SC, ST and PwD students; applications open from September each year.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Official current programme identity and annual opening pattern; detailed 2026-27 thresholds remain partner-sourced until an official rule page is published.

hardened_evidence.notes: Current-cycle source; not a substitute for clause-level eligibility.

source.title: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students – myScheme

hardened_evidence.evidence_text: myScheme states Swanath covers orphans, wards of parents who died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action; family income is not more than ₹8 lakh; study is in AICTE-approved degree/diploma programmes; current-year income and category-specific evidence are listed.
hardened_evidence.evidence_summary: Official scheme-page eligibility and document evidence for Swanath.
